claim: Every subgraph of the specified 769-point host on at most 508 vertices is four-colourable.

host.description: The 509-point nine-move seed together with the union of the 126 fresh field-valued unit triangles enumerated by the cyclic-batch package.

discovery_search.method: Seventeen deterministic seed-first critical-core passes followed by an exact eight-vertex deletion lattice and positive extension-cover generation.
discovery_search.note: The private solver search discovered the boundary. The published theorem is checked solely from explicit proper colourings and a solver-free finite cover calculation.
